observations: R1's historical Python 3.9 / torch 2.4 / vLLM 0.6 stack is not a demonstrated Qwen3.5 runtime.
Pinned VeRL supplies a Qwen3.5 FSDP2/vLLM example, but that example uses GRPO, a 35B policy and multiple GPUs: not proof of our PPO actor/critic on one H100.
Pinned VeRL requires transformers >=5.5.3, !=5.6.0, <5.13; the existing isolated Transformers 5.13.0 infrastructure-smoke environment must not be reused or upgraded into a VeRL training environment.
required_next_gates: Resolve and freeze an isolated VeRL dependency lock supporting Qwen3.5 text-only actor, reference and value head.
Verify generation/trainer log-probability parity at identical weights, tokens, masks, dtype and decoding settings.
Verify full N-minus-1 trajectories, gamma=1 reward placement on each action's final response token, and actor/reference/critic forward/backward.
Run bounded 20-30 episode PPO smoke including checkpoint save/reload on one genuinely idle H100; record actual peak VRAM and release immediately.
Do not replace PPO with GRPO or alter model/parameterization/GPU topology without an explicit design amendment.
